frontPage.headline: Cabinet Approves VISTAR Scheme to Modernize India's Statistical Framework
frontPage.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved the VISTAR scheme aimed at transforming India's data collection and statistical architecture into a real-time, technology-driven system. The initiative incorporates artificial intelligence and improves coverage of the unorganized sector to enhance GDP accuracy and reduce policy blind spots.
frontPage.whyItMatters: Reliable and timely economic statistics are essential for evidence-based policymaking, targeted welfare delivery, and accurate macroeconomic planning under the Vision 2047 framework.

frontPage.headline: Cabinet Sanctions ₹14,500 Crore Viability Gap Funding for Energy Storage Infrastructure
frontPage.summary: The Union Cabinet approved a ₹14,500 crore Viability Gap Funding (VGF) scheme to accelerate large-scale energy storage development across India. The scheme targets Hydro Pumped Storage Plants (PSP), Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), and alternative storage technologies.
frontPage.whyItMatters: Energy storage is critical for integrating intermittent renewable power into the national grid, facilitating India's energy transition and climate commitments under Nationally Determined Contributions.

frontPage.headline: Historical Manuscripts Added to UNESCO Memory of the World Regional Register
frontPage.summary: Ancient Indian manuscripts including the Mahabharata, Arthashastra, and Rajatarangini have been formally inscribed in the UNESCO Memory of the World Regional Register for Asia-Pacific. The inscription highlights global recognition of India's classical textual heritage.
frontPage.whyItMatters: Preservation of literary heritage connects directly to GS I Art & Culture syllabus topics on ancient texts, historiography, and global heritage recognition.

frontPage.headline: Mines Ministry Initiates 9th Round of Critical Mineral Block Auctions
frontPage.summary: The Ministry of Mines launched the ninth tranche of critical mineral auctions offering 20 blocks, bringing total offered blocks to 100. Simultaneously, the Centre earmarked ₹2,814 crore to bolster domestic processing of key energy minerals like lithium and nickel.
frontPage.whyItMatters: Securing domestic critical mineral supply chains reduces import vulnerability for green technologies, electric vehicles, defense, and high-tech manufacturing.

frontPage.headline: NPCI Defends Merchant Discount Rate on UPI Before Supreme Court
frontPage.summary: The National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) informed the Supreme Court that a zero-Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) model is no longer sustainable for Unified Payments Interface (UPI) systems. NPCI argued that financial contributions are required to maintain system resilience, security, and infrastructure expansion.
frontPage.whyItMatters: Balancing public digital infrastructure growth with financial sustainability is a core economic governance challenge for India's digital economy.

frontPage.headline: Study Reveals Decadal Expansion in Mangrove Cover Across Coastal Kerala
frontPage.summary: A remote-sensing study by the ICAR-Central Marine Fisheries Research Institute (CMFRI) showed a net expansion of mangrove ecosystems along Kerala's coast over the past decade, reversing earlier trends of degradation.
frontPage.whyItMatters: Mangroves serve as natural bio-shields against coastal erosion, extreme weather events, and carbon sequestration reservoirs.

gs1.headline: UNESCO Inscribes Classical Indian Manuscripts in Regional Heritage Register
gs1.summary: Manuscripts of the epic Mahabharata, Kautilya's Arthashastra, and Kalhana's Rajatarangini were formally added to the UNESCO Memory of the World Regional Register for Asia-Pacific. The decision acknowledges the deep historical and literary influence of ancient Indian codices.
gs1.whyItMatters: Directly relevant to GS Paper I requirements covering Indian art, literature, ancient polity texts, and historical chronicles.

gs2.headline: Election Commission Extends Form Submission Opportunity for Left-Out Electors in 7 States
gs2.summary: The Election Commission of India has issued fresh directions granting eligible voters omitted from draft Special Summary Revision (SIR) electoral rolls another chance to submit claims in seven states/UTs, including Delhi, Maharashtra, and Telangana.
gs2.whyItMatters: Ensures universal adult suffrage, voter inclusivity, and transparent electoral roll maintenance managed by an independent constitutional body.

gs2.headline: Gauhati High Court Quashes Preventive Detention of Environmental Activist Under NSA
gs2.summary: The Gauhati High Court set aside the detention of an activist under the National Security Act (NSA), invoked shortly after he received bail for protests near Kaziranga National Park. The court cited procedural irregularities and misuse of executive power.
gs2.whyItMatters: Highlights judicial safeguards protecting personal liberty under Article 21 against arbitrary preventive detention laws.

gs2.headline: Supreme Court Protects Past Promotions in Creamy Layer OBC Dispute
gs2.summary: The Supreme Court clarified that its earlier rulings on the OBC creamy layer exclusion will safeguard past completed appointments and promotions, preventing retroactive disruption while allowing ongoing litigation to proceed.
gs2.whyItMatters: Maintains administrative stability and balances public employment jurisprudence with affirmative action principles.

gs3.headline: Union Cabinet Launches VISTAR Scheme for Real-Time Economic Data
gs3.summary: The Union Cabinet has introduced the VISTAR scheme to modernise national statistical collection using advanced digital tools and AI, focusing on accurate measurements of informal sector contributions to GDP.
gs3.whyItMatters: Addresses structural data lag in Indian macroeconomic policy, improving GDP estimation and planning accuracy.

gs3.headline: Cabinet Approves ₹14,500 Crore Viability Gap Funding for Energy Storage
gs3.summary: A financial outlay of ₹14,500 crore under Viability Gap Funding has been approved to build utility-scale battery storage and pumped hydro storage assets to manage grid stability.
gs3.whyItMatters: Key intervention to achieve 500 GW non-fossil energy capacity by 2030 and maintain grid stability.

gs3.headline: ISRO Reports Navigation Satellite NVS-03 Health as Optimal in Orbit
gs3.summary: ISRO confirmed that the NVS-03 satellite is healthy and undergoing in-orbit payload tests. NVS-03 forms part of the second-generation NavIC navigation constellation featuring atomic clock enhancements.
gs3.whyItMatters: Strengthens India's sovereign satellite navigation capabilities and reduces dependence on foreign GPS networks.

gs3.headline: Excessive Ethanol Blending in Fuel Detected Above E20 Limits in Karnataka
gs3.summary: State laboratory testing revealed ethanol content reaching up to 31% in commercial petrol samples labeled as E20 in Karnataka, raising concerns regarding vehicle engine safety and quality assurance mechanisms of Oil Marketing Companies.
gs3.whyItMatters: Exposes regulatory and standardization challenges in executing national biofuel blending programs.

quiz.question: Which of the following ancient Indian works were recently added to the UNESCO Memory of the World Regional Register for Asia-Pacific?
options: C) Rigveda, Sama Veda, and Yajur Veda
quiz.explanation: The UNESCO Memory of the World Regional Register for Asia-Pacific recently inscribed ancient manuscripts of the Mahabharata, Kautilya's Arthashastra, and Kalhana's Rajatarangini.

quiz.question: The primary objective of the newly approved VISTAR scheme by the Union Cabinet is to:
options: A) Construct expressways along border zones
B) Modernize data collection and statistical systems in real time
D) Expand urban housing under PMAY
quiz.explanation: VISTAR focuses on overhauling India's statistical infrastructure by integrating real-time data, AI, and comprehensive coverage of informal economic sectors.

quiz.question: Cellophane bees are scientifically unique because they:
options: A) Produce natural biodegradable plastic linings for their nests
B) Do not consume nectar from flowering plants
C) Build floating hives on freshwater lakes
D) Are completely immune to synthetic pesticides
quiz.explanation: Ground-nesting cellophane bees synthesize a natural polymer resembling translucent plastic that protects their eggs and degrades naturally within a year.

quiz.question: The Viability Gap Funding (VGF) scheme allocated ₹14,500 crore by the Cabinet is designed to support:
options: B) Large-scale energy storage systems such as BESS and Pumped Hydro
quiz.explanation: The ₹14,500 crore VGF scheme targets grid-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) and hydro pumped storage projects.

schemes.name: VISTAR (Visionary Initiative for Statistical Transformation and Real-time Analytics)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
schemes.beneficiaries: Policymakers, economic analysts, national statistics bodies, public institutions
schemes.objective: To overhaul India's national statistical system into a real-time, technology-driven architecture with enhanced unorganized sector sampling.
keyFeatures: Integration of Artificial Intelligence in data verification
Enhanced methodology for unorganized sector GDP representation
schemes.upscRelevance: GS III: Economic planning, resource mobilization, and data governance.

schemes.name: Viability Gap Funding (VGF) Scheme for Energy Storage Systems
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Power / Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
schemes.beneficiaries: Power distribution companies, renewable energy developers, national grid operators
schemes.objective: To de-risk capital investment in utility-scale energy storage systems for grid stability.
keyFeatures: Targets integration of variable renewable power
schemes.upscRelevance: GS III: Renewable energy infrastructure, climate change mitigation.
